description: This is a PHP unit test class for the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy in the OrangeHRM project. It tests the purge functionality on Employee entities, verifying that fields are replaced with specific values according to configured strategies.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy's functionality on Employee entities, ensuring correct data purge behavior as per configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets up replacement strategy with configuration, and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Tests the purge method to verify that employee fields are replaced with expected values.

methods.name: testPurgeRecord
methods.description: Tests the purgeRecord method to ensure individual Employee entity is correctly purged and persisted.

methods.name: testGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Verifies that the getReplaceStrategy method returns instances of the correct formatting classes based on strategy names.

methods.name: invokeProtectedGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the protected getReplaceStrategy method within the class for testing purposes.
